ra: In Zurvanism Ohrmazd and Ahriman are twin brothers, both born of Zurvan — distinct from orthodox Mazdaism where the antagonist of the destructive spirit is Spenta Mainyu, not Ahura Mazda himself (Zaehner, Zurvan, 1955).
Zurvan akarana ('Boundless Time') is the eternal/infinite aspect-name of the time-god Zurvan in the Pahlavi sources (Zaehner, Zurvan, 1955, pp. 89-105 on the doctrine of the two zurvans).
Zurvan daregho-chvadhata ('Time of Long Dominion') is the finite, measured aspect-name of Zurvan — the bounded world-cycle issuing from Boundless Time (Zaehner, Zurvan, 1955, pp. 89-105).

In the Zurvanite cosmology Finite Time (daregho-chvadhata), the 9,000/12,000-year cycle within which the cosmic battle unfolds, is carved out of / issues from Boundless Time (akarana) so that the conflict may reach resolution (Zaehner, Zurvan, 1955, pp. 219ff.).
